# UARB saved-list samples

Public **Save List** exports for matter M12205, downloaded from the UARB
WebDirect site on October 24, 2026. These are list reports, not the document
attachments or confidential document contents.

- `exhibits.pdf`: 13 exhibit records across two pages, including wrapped titles
  and exhibit numbers such as `H-4(C)-iii`.
- `key-documents.pdf`: six numeric document numbers.
- `other-documents.pdf`: 43 records across three pages, including confidential
  listings. All six Key Documents also appear in this report.

The union contains 56 distinct document/exhibit numbers. This does not establish
the number of binary attachments within those document records.
